_meta.definition: The process of maintaining, updating, collecting, and analyzing player data and statistics.

People._description: Captures personal and biographical data of baseball players throughout their lives.

columns.name: ﻿ID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the ﻿ entity

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: birthYear
columns.description: Stores the year a person was born.

columns.name: birthMonth
columns.description: Stores the month of birth for individuals, ranging from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

columns.name: birthDay
columns.description: Stores baseball players' birthdays as 4-digit year of birth.

columns.name: birthCity
columns.description: Stores the city of birth for individuals in the People table.

columns.name: birthCountry
columns.description: Stores the country of birth for individuals in the People table.

columns.name: birthState
columns.description: Stores the state where players were born (e.g., CO, AL, CA, FL).

columns.name: deathYear
columns.description: Stores the year a person in the LahmanBaseball database passed away.

columns.name: deathMonth
columns.description: Stores the month (1-12) of a person's death in the People table.

columns.name: deathDay
columns.description: Stores the day of a person's death (1-31), as an integer.

columns.name: deathCountry
columns.description: Stores the country where a person died (all instances are USA).

columns.name: deathState
columns.description: Records the state where individuals in the People table passed away (based on sample values).

columns.name: deathCity
columns.description: Stores cities where people died.

columns.name: nameFirst
columns.description: Stores first names of individuals in the People table, as exemplified by David, Hank, Tommie, Don, and Andy.

columns.name: nameLast
columns.description: Stores the last names of people in baseball, as demonstrated by examples Aardsma, Aaron, Abad.

columns.name: nameGiven
columns.description: Stores first names of individuals, as demonstrated by examples David, Henry, Tommie, Donald, and Fausto.

columns.name: weight
columns.description: Stores the weight of baseball players, typically in pounds.

columns.name: height
columns.description: Stores player heights in inches (rounded down) based on sample values.

columns.name: bats
columns.description: Players' preferred batting hand (Right or Left)

columns.name: throws
columns.description: Stores a player's handedness (R for right-handed, L for left-handed) in baseball.

columns.name: debut
columns.description: Stores baseball players' professional debut dates (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: bbrefID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the bbref entity

columns.name: finalGame
columns.description: Stores dates of players' final Major League Baseball games.

columns.name: retroID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the retro entity
